violation_type.title: Toddler Care Area - Allows for Proper Supervision (26 TAC §747.2403(2))
violation_type.short_title: Toddler Care Area - Allows for Proper Supervision
violation_type.typical_finding: A 3  month old infant was lying in a bouncer in a bedroom with the door closed.  The child was awake but was  not being supervised properly.
